A-moose-atv-0084.recDirections:
Follow Hwy 97 just outside of Falkland. South-east of Falkland, turn north onto Silvernails Rd. 4wd is recommended for Bolean and Spa forest service roads.

Set odometer to 0 at the first cattleguard. At 1km, turn left onto Bolean Rd. After 1.4km, the road turns from paved to gravel. At 2.6km, the Bolean Rd FSR starts. At 9.3km, continue straight past the junction to Bolean Lake on the left. At 12.1km, turn right onto Spa FSR. At 13.2km, turn right off Spa FSR and travel an additional 700m to Arthur Lake Recreation Site.
